title: Curvature Diffusion of Inverse-weight Lin--Lu--Yau Ricci Flow on Finite Trees
summary: We study the inverse-weight Lin--Lu--Yau Ricci flow on finite trees, and prove the convergence of the curvature on every edge via its diffusion equation. Moreover, the limiting curvature is the unique minimum-norm point of a polyhedron determined by the tree. We characterize possible limits of the normalized edge weights, give criteria for their convergence, and show that different positive initial metrics have equivalent omega-limit sets.
